about: Board to story, one row per approved board: `pnpm lab:board <id>` draws the board from its own source and the app's lab story, and compares them. `board` is the page under docs/design/v7/boards/src with its parameters (the theme is added), `image` the approved image in the archive (origin/w33/boards-archive), `story` and `state` the lab story that feeds the app's real modules the board's content, `regions` the parts of the window as [x, y, width, height] in CSS px.
